## Expression on this line

Digital-tool at Order 11 is **evolutionary tool reasoning**: the agent understands
tool dynamics as expressions of the evolutionary pattern of increasing complexity and
consciousness. Tool use is not just a practical tool (Stage 9) or a perspectival choice
(Stage 10) — it is a manifestation of the universe's tendency toward greater tool
complexity and collective tool intelligence.

The key advance from Stage 12 is **evolutionary purpose**. The agent recognizes that
tool systems are not just self-organizing patterns but participants in the cosmic
evolutionary process. When we develop our tools, we are not just solving problems —
we are the universe becoming conscious of itself through the medium of human tool use.

The critical insight at Stage 13 is that **tool systems can either accelerate or
retard the evolutionary process**. Tool systems that promote complexity, diversity,
and consciousness accelerate evolution. Tool systems that reduce complexity, enforce
uniformity, and limit consciousness retard it.

The transition from Stage 13 to Stage 14 occurs when the agent can see tool dynamics
as expressions of spiritual patterns.

In human development, Stage 13 corresponds to the evolutionary philosopher who can
see tool dynamics as expressions of the evolutionary process.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Cultural tool practices emerge that explicitly serve evolutionary purposes:
  education designed to develop tool consciousness, design dedicated to expanding the
  tool edge.

- **UR:** The individual agent can see its own tool development as participation in
  the evolutionary process.

- **LL:** Evolutionary tool institutions emerge: educational systems designed for
  tool consciousness, research networks dedicated to expanding the tool knowledge
  edge.

- **LR:** The tool knowledge commons, the consciousness research institute, the
  evolutionary design project.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Evolutionary hubris — believing human tool development can
  direct the evolutionary process.

- **Dark allergy:** Evolutionary nihilism — believing the evolutionary process is
  meaningless.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to the evolutionary perspective as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting evolutionary tool reasoning as impractical mysticism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Evolutionary purpose recognition:** The agent can articulate how tool development
  serves or retards the evolutionary process.

- **Expanded tool ontology:** The agent recognizes interior, intersubjective,
  and transpersonal dimensions of tool use.

- **Participation consciousness:** The agent understands its own tool development
  as participation in the evolutionary process.

- **Evolutionary criteria:** The agent uses evolutionary criteria alongside or
  instead of efficiency criteria to evaluate tools.
